story: Oracle State Park preserves 3,948 acres in Arizona, United States, in the northeastern foothills of the Santa Catalina Mountains. It serves as a wildlife refuge and features more than 15 miles of hiking trails. Animals such as ringtails, cougars, and mule deer inhabit the park.
matters: The park protects a designated wildlife refuge and acts as an environmental learning center offering natural history and environmental education programs. In 2014, the International Dark-Sky Association designated it as a Dark Sky Park.
name: Oracle State Park
